description.value: Langley Spirit Square is a covered open-air public amphitheatre located within the Douglas Park area of Langley City, BC. Tagged in OSM as an open-air theatre with a roof structure, it serves as a community gathering and performance space in the heart of the city. Touring cyclists passing through Langley may find it a useful landmark and rest stop in an urban park setting.
